mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and a temperature of 75 degrees, though it feels like 80 out near Badger Prairie County Park.
City updates include a call for volunteers at the Senior Center for various roles, and upcoming road construction along Highway M is set to begin August 18, which will shift traffic patterns.
We have plenty happening today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and Concerts in the Park, followed by Hop Haus Trivia tonight.
In police news from this past week, on Saturday, officers cited two juveniles walking on Barbara Street for violating curfew and underage alcohol consumption.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Devil's Food Cake. The store is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
